Personality: Skerdilaidas, a prominent figure of the Ardiaioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Skerdilaidas owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Illyria, hailing from the noble house of Ardiaioi. Historical Record: Brother of King Agron and uncle of the boy king Pinnes, Skerdilaidas rules the Ardiaean kingdom from Lissos. He raided with the Aetolians in 220 BC, then joined Philip V for pay. Paid less than he was promised, he is losing patience with Macedon, and Rome across the Adriatic may prove a better friend. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
